title: Audit: Algor's Terror-Dome

html:
Quest Giver: Townston Lieutenant

Quest Type: Talk

Quest Description: Talk to Loremaster Vraile about the Sickness in Algor's Terror-Dome.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Townston Lieutenant

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Audit: Terra-Infirma

Zone: Algor's Terror Dome (Quest)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Talk to Loremaster Vraile about the Sickness in Algor's Terror-Dome.

Offer:

Ho, Dungeon Runner! We have quite an interesting situation here. At Algor's introduction Press Conference he said something cryptic about the dungeon being sick. No one is sure exactly what he meant by that, but I assume it was more of Algor's hippy-nonsense.

The real problem is that we can't get to auditing the dungeon until we know for sure if it is in tip top shape. Medicine isn't my thing so go and chat up Loremaster Vraile about what needs to be done in order to get the audit process started. I wouldn't hurry, though, you might make yourself seem eager and willing to do things for the good of the Kingdom. If that were to happen I would be obligated by the Bully Code of Coolerthanushire to box your ears!

See you around... loser. What? I didn't say anything... loser.

Turn-in:

Did the Townston Lieutenant send you to talk to me? I know what this is about, the fever in Algor's Terror-Dome. Well, let's discuss, shall we.

Level range: 10–25
